name: 机器学习分类
starting_prompt: 使用机器学习进行分类预测

parameters.r_packages: caret, glmnet, randomForest, e1071, pROC, shapviz
parameters.steps: Feature selection (LASSO) -> Train/test split -> Random Forest -> SVM training -> ROC/AUC evaluation -> SHAP explanation

detailed_description:
LASSO+RandomForest+SVM+SHAP解释, 支持bulk和scRNA

适用场景: disease, 有标签数据, 分类/预测

分析步骤:
  - Feature selection (LASSO): cv.glmnet sparse features
  - Train/test split: createDataPartition 70/30
  - Random Forest: randomForest + OOB
  - SVM training: svm + cross-validation
  - ROC/AUC evaluation: pROC multi-model comparison
  - SHAP explanation: shapviz feature importance

依赖包: shapviz, e1071, scikit-learn, caret, shap, glmnet, optuna, pROC, xgboost, randomForest

难度: advanced

触发提示: "使用机器学习进行分类预测"
when_to_use: 适用于: disease, 有标签数据, 分类/预测
